summary: Marked right-sided pleural and parenchymal opacification has increased.

findings.rationale: There is much greater homogeneous veiling of the right lower hemithorax on the current image, obscuring the right base and favoring a larger effusion; AP technique may accentuate size.
Above the effusion, the right perihilar to upper/mid lung is more densely opaque than on prior, suggesting worsening airspace collapse/consolidation.
